scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: 貝 seven and the 士 of 賣 (8-10) match, but the dictionary writes the middle of 賣 as 四 with 儿 inside (a 丿 and a 乚, 13-14) where the licensed MM original draws 罒 with two inner verticals. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 瀆·犢·牘·竇 were

犭 three and the 龶 top of 靑 (4-7) match, but the dictionary writes the bottom of 靑 as 円 with a short vertical hanging from the top to the bar (10) before that bar (11), where the licensed MM original draws 月 with two inner bars. Order and direction cannot bridge the form difference, so the glyph is held, as 鯖 was for 靑·青
